summary: After the accepted bounded makewish, corpse-drop, and offering fixes, the v43 same-seed replay first differs at step 291: successful prayer reaches pray.c:pleased case 6, which calls the wholly unported pray.c:give_spell. Preserve the exact object-generation, spell-learning, message, and RNG order for every branch.
